capabilities: manage Google Tasks from a side panel
sync tasks two-way with Google Tasks
extras: README is mostly in Indonesian and points setup instructions (plugin activation and Google OAuth credential creation) to a separate docs/oauth-setup.md file; the plugin is at Phase 0 (OAuth spike) and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.

relations.evidence: Two-way sync dengan Google Tasks API.

summary: Side panel for managing Google Tasks with two-way sync through the Google Tasks API.
